work_item: B04 exact-key inner join of two headered CSV tables through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No test or ordinary CLI route was run in this implementation slice; verification was limited to formatting, compilation, lint, build and static diff checks.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Engine::execute/execute_inner -> input::seal -> input::interpret -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CsvInnerJoin -> document::csv_inner_join -> DocumentResult artifact -> Core dependencies and rendered output
input_contract: After a csv-inner-join header, the body has exactly one --- MINIDORA LEFT CSV --- marker line and one CRLF-prefixed --- MINIDORA RIGHT CSV --- marker line, separating two explicitly headered CSV tables. Marker text is reserved.
supported_behavior: The Japanese header CSVを「left-key」と「right-key」で内部結合して: and strict quoted English csv-inner-join "left-key" "right-key": select the key column on each side.
Both payloads must parse as bounded headered RFC 4180 CSV with unique decoded header names and consistent record widths.

Each selected key must be unique on its own side. Matching uses exact decoded string equality without trimming, case folding, Unicode normalization or numeric interpretation; duplicates suspend rather than expanding rows.

The output is a JSON string-table object with left.<column> and right.<column> namespaces, retaining all columns including both keys. Matched rows follow left-table order; unmatched left and right keys are reported separately.

The DocumentResult retains the combined original input, its digest, output digest, source record numbers for matched rows, and exact source byte spans and decoded values for emitted headers and cells.
The combined input and output are bounded at 256000 bytes; each CSV table is bounded at 4096 rows, 256 columns and 65536 cells. The serialized source-span envelope is also capped at 256000 bytes.
known_limits: No test or ordinary CLI route was executed for this slice.
Only inner joins with explicitly named unique keys are supported; outer joins, duplicate-key expansion, inferred schemas and headerless inputs are unsupported.
The transformation reports supplied string values and does not infer semantic equivalence or factual truth.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
